HAL Partners with Adani, BEML for Helicopter Production

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has entered into a partnership with Adani Defence and Aerospace and Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML) for the production of fuselage structures for Light Combat Helicopters (LCH) Prachand. This collaboration aims to enhance domestic manufacturing capabilities for critical defense components. The agreement focuses on the production of fuselage structures, a key element in the construction of these advanced helicopters.
